mapper.update: UPDATE inspect_plan_project pp SET pp.total_count = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM station s WHERE s.project_id = pp.project_id), pp.inspected_count = (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT(r.station_id)) FROM inspect_record r WHERE r.plan_project_id = pp.id AND r.status = 1) WHERE pp.plan_id = #{planId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM inspect_plan_project pp INNER JOIN inspect_plan p ON p.id = pp.plan_id WHERE pp.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.status IN (0, 1)
